key.name: allowed-apps
key.summary: Focus with an allow-list: only these apps (desktop ids) stay visible; empty keeps every app

key.name: focus-on
key.summary: Focus mode is on. The quick-settings tile and the clock menu's switch both follow it, and so can a script (ostrich config set focus focus-on true); it is false after a restart of the shell

key.name: saved-show-banners
key.summary: Notification banner setting from before focus mode ('' when focus is off); restored if the shell restarts mid-focus
